scheme_name: Permanent Disability/ Death Benefit for the Construction Workers
other_conditions: The applicant must have served the Sikkim Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board for at least 90 days in a given year
The applicant must be a nominee or dependent of a registered worker who has died or is permanently disabled due to an accident during the course of employment
benefits_summary: Provides a ₹150,000 death benefit (and an equivalent permanent disability benefit) to eligible nominees or dependents.
